architecture: Frozen MobileNet v2 alpha 1.0 224px / 1280 embedding -> Dense(128, ReLU) -> Dropout(0.3 training only) -> Dense(9) -> temperature-scaled softmax

policy.selection: Validation only: temperature minimizes NLL; maximize coverage with >=30 suggestions and >=80% suggestion accuracy; fallback threshold 0.9 / margin 0.2.

training: New head only; original feature extractor frozen. Class-balanced loss, training-only horizontal flips, L2, dropout, Adam 0.0005, validation-loss early stopping (patience 10).
backend: TensorFlow 2.16.2 CPU / original TensorFlow.js MobileNet graph; NumPy calibration
limitations: Hazardous examples cover batteries only; other hazards are not validated.
Same-source public holdout; not independent local photos.
Perceptual duplicate grouping is heuristic; physical-object identities are unavailable.
Scores do not establish composition, toxicity or recycling eligibility.
